description: Celecoxib, a selective COX-2 NSAID, was prescribed despite a documented allergy to non-selective NSAIDs without any documented safety discussion or monitoring plan.
evidence_in_history: Current Medication List includes Celecoxib 200 mg twice daily; Allergy Record documents NSAIDs (non-selective) allergy with gastrointestinal upset.
evidence_in_summary: Note states Celecoxib was prescribed despite documented NSAID allergy without documented safety discussion or monitoring plan.
suggested_correction: Document clinical rationale and safety monitoring for use of selective NSAID in patient with NSAID allergy; consider allergy testing or alternative medications if necessary.

description: Aspirin continuation or discontinuation at discharge is unclear; discharge medications do not list Aspirin though it was on admission medication list.
evidence_in_history: Current Medication List includes Aspirin 81 mg once daily.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge medications omit Aspirin; no explicit statement about discontinuation or continuation.
suggested_correction: Explicitly document aspirin continuation or discontinuation at discharge to avoid medication reconciliation errors.

description: No documented confirmation or scheduling of primary care follow-up for management of hypertension and diabetes mellitus after discharge.

suggested_correction: Document confirmed primary care follow-up appointment or clear patient instructions to ensure chronic disease management continuity.

description: Physical therapy plan lacks detailed schedule and follow-up adherence documentation post-discharge.

description: No documented instructions regarding ongoing fall risk reassessment or monitoring for potential prosthetic complications post-discharge.
